entities.name: EBA (European Banking Authority)

entities.name: Crypto-Assets Act (MiCA in Norwegian law)
entities.description: MiCA (EU) 2023/1114 applies as Norwegian law from 1 Jul 2025; transition for registered VASPs until 30 Dec 2025 / until a licence decision.

entities.name: Firi
entities.description: CASP licence (MiCA Art. 63) from 22 May 2026: trading platform, custody, exchange, order execution and transfer (Finanstilsynet). Also an e-money institution licence from 3 Jun 2024 (Finanstilsynet's register). About 417,000 customers and a Swedish launch in Sep 2026 – according to Shifter, 15 Sep 2026.

entities.name: NBX (Norwegian Block Exchange)
entities.description: CASP licence registered 29 Jun 2026 (7 services) and an e-money institution (22 Jan 2024), according to Finanstilsynet's register. Listed on Euronext Growth; chair Nils Kristian Sundling. Held about 24 BTC on 30 Jun 2026 and 28 BTC in Aug 2026, according to NBX's H1 2026 report (18 Sep 2026).

entities.name: K33
entities.description: CASP licence registered 16 Jun 2026 (Finanstilsynet's register): custody, order execution and transfer; passports within the EEA.

entities.name: Bare Bitcoin
entities.description: CASP licence registered 26 Jun 2026 (Finanstilsynet's register): custody, exchange and transfer – bitcoin only. Rogstad is a co-founder according to Shifter, 19 Jul 2026.

entities.name: Týr Markets
entities.description: First exchange platform with a CASP licence in Norway (18 May 2026): custody, exchange and transfer.

entities.name: AK Jensen Norway
entities.description: Investment firm (since 26 Feb 2021) with the CASP services (g) reception and transmission of orders and (i) portfolio management, registered 2 Feb 2026 – according to Finanstilsynet's register. Not a former exchange or custody provider.

entities.name: Exchanges that closed in 2026
entities.description: Bitmynt, JuJu and Bitcoin Norway shut down around the MiCA deadline, according to Shifter (19 Jul 2026). JuJu's customers went to NBX, confirmed in NBX's half-year report (customer base acquisition completed 30 Jun 2026, more than 4,000 customers). Bitcoin Norway's customers went to Týr.

entities.name: DNB
entities.description: Offers crypto ETPs, not spot trading, and its crypto fund was paused in autumn 2025 – according to BankShift (17 Nov 2025). Joined the banks' CBMT test network for tokenised deposits in kroner – according to Kaupr (16 Sep 2026). Not part of Qivalis – according to Kaupr.

entities.name: Norges Bank's tokenisation network
entities.description: DNB Carnegie, DNB, Kommunalbanken, Citi, Lokalbank, SpareBank 1, Bits, KLP, Eika, Euronext, Nordea and SEB were named by Norges Bank in its own LinkedIn post (7 Sep 2026) as participants in exploring tokenisation, according to Kaupr (8 Sep 2026). Not published on norges-bank.no.

entities.name: SpareBank 1 banks
entities.description: Strict documentation and AML requirements for deposits coming from crypto platforms, according to SpareBank 1 Sogn og Fjordane's website. No integrated crypto service is confirmed.

entities.name: Crypto miners in Nkom's data-centre register
entities.description: Troll Housing AS (97%), Thermaltech AS (100%), Exanorth AS (100%), Currency Edge AS (100%), Arctic Flux AS (95%), Bluebite GmbH (55%), Bluefjords AS (14%), Nordic Blocks AS (1%) – share of capacity used for crypto mining. Two figures with different units: (1) Nkom's list on 3 Oct 2026 – 8 of 60 commercial data-centre operators report crypto mining (in-house data centres are not published). (2) The minister's answer of 18 Sep 2026 (Doc. 15:3707) – 9 registered data centres doing crypto mining.

entities.name: Tydal Data Center (Bitdeer)
entities.description: Bitdeer's Norwegian campus in Tydal is being converted to AI/HPC (121 IT-MW lease, Aug 2026); listed without crypto mining by Nkom.

entities.name: Seetee

entities.name: Schibsted Ventures

entities.name: The Mint

entities.name: Fintech Norway

entities.description: Global crypto exchange. Its European entity, OKX Europe, is authorised as a crypto-asset service provider in Malta and listed in ESMA's CASP register with passporting to Norway, Sweden, Denmark, Finland and Iceland. It launched in Sweden, Finland and Denmark in June 2025, and Norway is documented from July 2025 (OKX's Nordic campaign from late July 2025 was open to residents of Norway).
